key: GROWLITHE: Grrr....rrowr! Rowr!
en: GROWLITHE: Grrr....rrowr! Rowr!
ja: ガーディ: グルル……ルルォ! ルォ!

key: Growlithe seems to be staring intently down the hole.
en: Growlithe seems to be staring intently down the hole.
ja: ガーディは、穴の中を一心に見つめているようだ。

key: GROWLITHE: Grrowrithe!
en: GROWLITHE: Grrowrithe!
ja: ガーディ: ガルルォ!

key: GROWLITHE: Rowr...
en: GROWLITHE: Rowr...
ja: ガーディ: ルォ……

key: \PN peers into the hole.
en: \PN peers into the hole.
ja: \PNは穴の中をのぞき込んだ。

key: A police officer can be seen!
en: A police officer can be seen!
ja: 警察官の姿が見える!

key: It doesn't look like he made it...
en: It doesn't look like he made it...
ja: 助からなかったようだ……

key: GROWLITHE: Grr... rowr, rowr, rowr!
en: GROWLITHE: Grr... rowr, rowr, rowr!
ja: ガーディ: グル……ルォ、ルォ、ルォ!

key: Growlithe seems to have run back to the police station.
en: Growlithe seems to have run back to the police station.
ja: ガーディは、警察署へと走って戻っていったようだ。

key: ???: I could have sworn there was one more section...
en: ???: I could have sworn there was one more section...
ja: ???: もう一区画、あったはずだと思ったのだが……

key: Disappointing.
en: Disappointing.
ja: 残念だ。

key: So this place also has nothing for me.
en: So this place also has nothing for me.
ja: この場所にも、私の求めるものはない、ということか。

key: ???: Ah, excuse me; I must not have heard you come in.
en: ???: Ah, excuse me; I must not have heard you come in.
ja: ???: ああ、失礼。あなたが入ってきたのに気づかなかったようだ。

key: Though, since you're here,
en: Though, since you're here,
ja: とはいえ、せっかくここにいるのだから、

key: ...And bearing in mind that calling this 'a shot in the dark' is still a very generous estimation of the chances here...
en: ...And bearing in mind that calling this 'a shot in the dark' is still a very generous estimation of the chances here...
ja: ……これを『当てずっぽう』と呼ぶのすら、まだ随分と甘い見積もりだと分かってはいるのだが……

key: Have you, perchance, ever heard of "Dreamsickness"?
en: Have you, perchance, ever heard of "Dreamsickness"?
ja: もしや、あなたは『ドリームシックネス』という言葉を聞いたことは?

key: You must tell me wherever from.
en: You must tell me wherever from.
ja: どこでそれを聞いたのか、ぜひ教えてほしい。

key: ...Ah, but I suppose that by its very nature, it is impossible to recall the source of.
en: ...Ah, but I suppose that by its very nature, it is impossible to recall the source of.
ja: ……ああ、だがその性質上、出どころを思い出すことなど、そもそも不可能なのだろうな。

key: Like trying to recount a dream that seemed so clear only moments ago, only to be met with complete oblivion upon telling it.
en: Like trying to recount a dream that seemed so clear only moments ago, only to be met with complete oblivion upon telling it.
ja: つい先ほどまであんなに鮮明だった夢を語ろうとしたとたん、まったくの忘却に行き当たるようなものだ。

key: But that it even sounds familiar to you is already curious.
en: But that it even sounds familiar to you is already curious.
ja: だが、それがあなたにとってどこか聞き覚えがあるように感じられること自体、すでに興味深い。

key: I suspect we will meet again.
en: I suspect we will meet again.
ja: また会うことになる気がする。

key: ???: I thought as much.
en: ???: I thought as much.
ja: ???: やはりそうか。

key: Worry not; it would have been an act greater than fate had you happened to.
en: Worry not; it would have been an act greater than fate had you happened to.
ja: 案ずるな。もしそうなっていたなら、それは運命を超えた業だったということになる。

key: Farewell.
en: Farewell.
ja: さらばだ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
